items.name: theme
items.title: MRI semantic theme
items.description: The semantic colour extension the preset does not ship: info, warning and notable, each with a fill, an ink-on-fill and a readable ink. Import it next to tailwindcss in app/globals.css.

items.name: agent-rules
items.title: MRI UI rules for agents
items.description: The imperative rule set for anyone editing an MRI interface, human or agent. Install it and reference it from AGENTS.md.

items.name: format
items.title: Shared formatting
items.description: Number, date and label formatting: grouped counts, integers, compact notation, deltas and ISO-safe dates. Dependency-free, so it installs anywhere — and the one place a numeral's treatment should be decided.

items.name: taxonomy
items.title: Portable domain vocabulary
items.description: The IUCN tone and label tables, the bird and observation record types, and countryFlag computed from an ISO code. No fixtures and no data, which is what makes specimen-card installable.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox, Phosphor import corrected
items.description: The preset checkbox with its icon import moved to /dist/ssr. Depending on the bare preset name instead overwrites a consumer's corrected file with the createContext hazard, which is exactly what happened to the platform twice.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: The single chip component: two surfaces (flow 20px, overlay 22px), seven tones, mandatory scrims on photographs. A span, not the preset Badge, because Badge cannot be recoloured.

items.name: chip-audit
items.title: Chip audit
items.description: Measures every rendered chip and reports any outside the two allowed sizes. Drop it on a review route.

items.name: ui-audit
items.title: UI audit
items.description: The enforcement harness: nineteen rules (the installed components/mri layer included) over class strings and stylesheets — the spacing scale, the type scale, hover translation, chart colours used as surface tints, hand-rolled chips, raw tables, colour literals, banned imports, unsanctioned CSS, icon entry points, hand-rolled data-card headers and table boxes, eyebrows inside a data card, shaded table headers, tables that drop no column on a phone, tables pinned wider than a phone, rows holding three data surfaces, page padding restated around PageContainer, and navigation links rendered through Button — with a baseline that may only shrink. Project-specific exemptions go in scripts/audit-ui.config.json, never in the script. Wire it into npm run verify.

items.name: spacing-audit
items.title: Spacing audit (deprecated)
items.description: Deprecated alias for ui-audit, kept so an existing install does not break. It installs the same file: the audit grew from one rule to six and the old name no longer describes it.

items.name: charts
items.title: Chart compositions
items.description: InatScanArea, InatTaxaBar, CountryBar, GroupedBar, StatusDonut, MultiLine and Sparkline, plus the olive CHART_COLORS ramp and CATEGORICAL — the nine-step identity ramp for charts that plot entities rather than magnitudes. Pairs with the theme item, which carries the ramp's tokens.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet, Phosphor import corrected
items.description: The preset sheet with its icon import moved to /dist/ssr. Install this *after* anything that pulls the preset sheet - `sidebar` does - or the bare entry overwrites it and the close button breaks Server Components.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar, Phosphor import corrected
items.description: The preset sidebar and its use-mobile hook, with the icon import moved to /dist/ssr. Depends on this repository's sheet rather than the preset's, because the preset's ships the bare Phosphor entry that breaks Server Components - the same defect that hit checkbox twice.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio player
items.description: The audio transport: circle play/pause, waveform, replay with its key hint, scrub track and tabular time. Caller-owned playback state, so one <audio> element can outlive a re-render. Takes surface=overlay to sit on a photograph. Pairs with the format item's formatDuration.

items.name: layout
items.title: Page layout primitives
items.description: PageContainer, PageHeader, SectionHeader and the specimen labels used to document a pattern. No dependencies: it is layout and text only.

items.name: patterns
items.title: Page patterns
items.description: Panel — the data card, with the title-carries-its-count header enforced rather than described — plus TableCard, DataRow (two data surfaces per row, splitting at xl so card width is monotonic in viewport width), MetricCard, MetricStrip, StatusBadge, FilterSidebar, StatusPath, RecordChange, the data states and the skeletons. The compositions a route composes from.

items.name: specimen-card
items.title: Specimen and media cards
items.description: ObservationCard and BirdMediaCard, plus IucnChip. The reference implementation of the overlay rules: two scrimmed chips at most, media facts on the image and record facts in the body.
